title: useColor Hook
description:
Implement a `useColor` hook that cycles through a color palette and returns `{ color, next, prev, index }`. `next()` advances to the next color (wrapping from last to first). `prev()` goes back (wrapping from first to last). `index` tracks the current position.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { color, next, prev, index } = useColor(['red', 'green', 'blue']);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: the prev wrap formula — (index - 1) % palette.length returns -1 in JavaScript when index is 0. The correct formula adds palette.length before taking the modulo: (index - 1 + palette.length) % palette.length.
